name: Slimebodied
description: An amorphous being of living gel. Food provides only 5% nourishment, but hunger drains at 25% normal rate and never while idle. Well-fed slimes gain up to 25% damage reduction. 10-second cooldown between meals. 75% base health, -50% armor toughness. Satiety never drops below 25%. Invest in high-quality food.
